name: TrailBase
line: Self-hosted SQLite backend with auth, file APIs, live updates, WASM code and jobs.

free.text: OSL-3.0; no vendor quota or idle expiry; you host and retain the data

cells.metered: No TrailBase fees; host and storage billed separately
cells.regions: Operator chooses server, file and backup locations

sql.math: $0 software fee. Host, kept disk, network and backup costs are unknown.
$0 software fee. 730 host hours, kept storage and backups are not priced.

files.math: TrailBase has no price per GB or per request. Host or S3 storage, network and backups are not priced.

jobs.math: No fee per job. Shared server resources, stored job state, logs and outside services are not priced.
